description_en: Queries agent information for the SDK
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-ati-agent-register-info-market --client-token eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cC..... --agent-host example.com --agent-version 5.0.1 --max-results 100 --next-token 4698691 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAtiAgentRegisterInfoMarket

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The owner ID of the authorization principal

AgentDescription.description_en: The description of the agent capabilities

AgentDisplayName.description_en: The display name of the agent

AgentHost.description_en: The host address of the agent

AgentId.description_en: The agent ID, which is assigned by CNNIC after real-name verification. The agent ID serves as the unique identifier that binds the agent to the real-name verified registrant
AgentId.description_zh: AgentID，经过CNNIC实名认证后，由CNNIC统一分配。AgentID作为Agent与实名认证注册人绑定的唯一标识

AgentRegisterInfoId.description_en: The agent registration ID. This ID is automatically generated by the Alibaba Cloud ATS platform and is globally unique within the platform. During the agent registration process, this ID is automatically generated. In the multi-step registration process through the API, this ID must be carried throughout all steps to ensure that each step is associated with the same agent and the complete registration process is completed
AgentRegisterInfoId.description_zh: AgentRegisterInfoId Agent注册ID。由阿里云 ATS 平台自动生成，在阿里云 ATS 平台具有全局唯一性。在 Agent 注册过程中自动生成，通过API注册的多步流程中，该 ID 必须全程携带，以确保各步骤关联至同一 Agent，完成完整的注册闭环

AgentUrl.description_en:
The actual service address of the agent endpoint, which is the HTTPS entry point where the agent runs online. This is a required field with a maximum of 500 characters.

Example: https://my-agent.example.com/mcp

Callers can initiate a connection directly using this URL after discovering the agent through DNS. This is the address where the agent is actually online
AgentUrl.description_zh:
该 Agent 端点的实际服务地址，即 Agent 在线运行的 HTTPS 入口。必填字段，最大 500 字符。

例如：https://my-agent.example.com/mcp
作用：调用方通过 DNS 发现到这个 Agent 后，拿到这个 URL 就可以直接发起连接。这是 Agent 真正"在线"的地址

MetadataUrl.description_en: An optional URL that points to the metadata description file of the agent, typically in JSON format. This URL allows other agents or clients to automatically discover the agent capabilities before connecting, including the functions supported by the agent, input/output formats, version information, and other capability declarations
MetadataUrl.description_zh: 一个可选的 URL 地址，指向该 Agent 的元数据描述文件（通常是 JSON 格式）。作用：让其他 Agent 或客户端在连接前，可以通过这个 URL 自动发现该 Agent 的能力描述，包括： Agent 支持哪些功能（functions） 输入/输出格式 版本信息 其他能力声明

Protocol.description_en:
The communication protocol standard that the agent endpoint follows, which determines how callers invoke the agent. Valid values:

MCP: Model Context Protocol, an agent tool calling protocol introduced by Anthropic.
A2A: Agent-to-Agent Protocol, a cross-agent communication protocol introduced by Google.
OpenAPI: Standard RESTful API specification (Swagger/OpenAPI).

Other agents or clients use this protocol identity to determine how to communicate with the agent. For example, MCP uses the MCP SDK, A2A uses the A2A SDK, and OpenAPI uses standard HTTP requests
Protocol.description_zh:
声明该 Agent 端点遵循的通信协议标准，决定调用方如何与该 Agent 交互： 协议 说明

MCP：Model Context Protocol，Anthropic 推出的 Agent 工具调用协议
A2A：Agent-to-Agent Protocol，Google 推出的跨 Agent 通信协议
OpenAPI：标准 RESTful API 规范（Swagger/OpenAPI）
作用：其他 Agent 或客户端看到这个协议标识后，就知道该用什么方式与它对话。比如 MCP 协议走 MCP SDK，A2A 走 A2A SDK，OpenAPI 走标准 HTTP 请求

items.description_en:
The communication transport mechanism supported by the agent endpoint, which works in conjunction with the protocol. The following table describes the mapping between protocols and available transport methods:

Protocol: MCP. Available transport methods: STREAMABLE-HTTP, SSE. Description: MCP supports streaming HTTP and Server-Sent Events.
Protocol: A2A. Available transport methods: STREAMABLE-HTTP, SSE. Description: A2A also supports these two transport methods.
Protocol: OpenAPI. Available transport methods: REST, HTTP. Description: Traditional REST API communication
items.description_zh: 该 Agent 端点支持的通信传输机制，与协议（protocol）联动： 协议 可选传输方式 说明 1、协议：MCP，可选传输方式：STREAMABLE-HTTP、SSE，说明：MCP 协议支持流式 HTTP 和 Server-Sent Events 2、协议：A2A，可选传输方式：STREAMABLE-HTTP、SSE，说明：A2A 协议同样支持这两种 3、协议：OpenAPI，可选传输方式：REST、HTTP，说明：传统 REST API 通信方式
